title: Criteria for Establishing Design Stress Intensity Values for Tables 2A and 2B
notes: NOTE: (1) For austenitic stainless steels, nickel alloys, copper alloys, and cobalt alloys having an S Y /S T ratio less than 0.625, the design stress in- tensity values in Tables 2A and 2B may exceed two‐thirds and may be as high as 90% of the yield strength at temperature.
